principle: Holy Books and other civilizational sources are sources; Wisdom is a derived, source-linked, context-bounded object. Source text, source claim, interpretation, wisdom, law and application must never be collapsed.

lanes.name: Source / Provenance
lanes.purpose: Preserve exact source, location, version, tradition, translation and custody.

lanes.name: Event / Narrative Pattern
lanes.purpose: Represent the source event or narrative as a Sequence-reconstructable pattern.

lanes.name: Cause → Consequence
lanes.purpose: Record supported relations between prior conditions, actions and consequences without collapsing temporal order into causality.

lanes.name: Duty / Role / Responsibility
lanes.purpose: Represent role-bound obligations, responsibilities and conflicts.

lanes.name: Value / Priority
lanes.purpose: Represent what is prioritized when multiple valid goals, duties or values conflict.

lanes.name: Rule / Restriction / Permission
lanes.purpose: Represent explicit or derived constraints, permissions and prohibitions with scope.

lanes.name: Promise / Commitment
lanes.purpose: Represent future-action commitments, activation conditions, persistence and closure.

lanes.name: Exception / Rule Conflict
lanes.purpose: Represent conflicts among rules, priority resolution, overrides, costs and consequences.

lanes.name: Human Condition
lanes.purpose: Connect narrative patterns to Human states such as desire, fear, attachment, loyalty, revenge, sacrifice, identity and social pressure without replacing the Human rubric.

lanes.name: Social Order
lanes.purpose: Represent family, society, governance, justice, power, institutions and collective consequences.

lanes.name: Inner Development
lanes.purpose: Represent awareness, discipline, restraint, learning, transformation and self-regulation patterns.

lanes.name: Long-Horizon Consequence
lanes.purpose: Track delayed, latent, multigenerational, systemic and era-level consequences.

lanes.name: Context / Applicability
lanes.purpose: State when a principle applies, when it does not, and which conditions must match.

lanes.name: Contradiction / Counter-Case
lanes.purpose: Preserve opposing cases, failed generalizations and incompatible interpretations.

lanes.name: Compressed Principle
lanes.purpose: Store a source-linked, context-qualified principle only after case comparison and falsification.

hard_guards: WISDOM_OBJECT cannot directly execute an action without context, conflict, rule and ASI-governance checks
Every derived wisdom object must retain source references and applicability boundaries
